items.heading: Ubugali with Beans
details: Key ingredients: cassava or corn flour, water, beans, tomato
Whisk cassava or corn flour into boiling water, stirring until it forms a stiff dough.
Continue kneading the dough in the pot until smooth and shiny.
Simmer beans with tomato, onion and oil until soft and saucy.
Serve the dough alongside the beans.

items.heading: Mukeke Fish Stew
details: Key ingredients: tilapia, tomato, onion, palm oil, chili
Clean and season whole tilapia fish.
Fry the fish briefly until lightly browned.
Simmer in a sauce of tomato, onion, chili and palm oil.
Cook until the fish is fully tender and serve with rice or ugali.
